            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re phung po lnga zhes pa de gzugs kyi chos su bskol na gzugs
            kyang yin la phung po 'ang yin pas gzugs kyi phung po zhes pa gzhi' mthun gyi drug pa yin
            la | <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="26a7"/> gzugs kyi phung po zhes pa'i phung po de gzugs las rdzas lasogs par byas na | gzugs las tha dad pa'i gzugs gyi phung po <expan>med</expan> pas de'i skyes bu'i drug pa <expan>yin no</expan> zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
